label: Selection endorses an act lacking a reason of the fixed verdict type in at most a d share
paraphrase: On one distribution of cases, the selected-for binary judgment B endorses an act for which the normative truth M, under one fixed verdict type, gives no reason, in a set of cases of measure at most d. This bounds only wrongly endorsed acts: it says nothing about acts that have a reason which B fails to endorse, nor about any single case, other distribution or other verdict type.
